name: SAP SuccessFactors
description: SAP SuccessFactors is a cloud human-capital-management suite for employee records, recruiting, onboarding, performance, compensation, learning, workforce planning, time, benefits, and talent processes. Organizations configure its people data, roles, workflows, custom objects, and country-specific employment processes for their workforce.
agentUseSummary: SAP SuccessFactors cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its OData v2 and v4 services expose tenant-specific metadata and broad create, read, update, delete, upsert, file, workflow, and business operations over highly sensitive workforce data. A tenant administrator must register an X.509-backed OAuth client and grant exact role-based permissions, but Relay has no approved module, entity, field, population, purpose, retention, or mutation contract from which to build bounded tools.

blocked.label: Connect SAP SuccessFactors
blocked.description: No generic delegated customer install is documented; a tenant administrator must register an X.509-backed client and grant instance-specific role-based API authority.

blocked.label: Read workforce data
blocked.description: Employee, candidate, applicant, compensation, payroll, benefits, leave, time, performance, learning, demographic, contact, medical, diversity, succession, and other people data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Change HCM records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, upserting, deleting, importing, exporting, approving, rejecting, advancing, hiring, terminating, paying, evaluating, assigning, enrolling, or otherwise changing workforce records or processes is blocked.

blocked.label: Administer SuccessFactors
blocked.description: Users, roles, permissions, OAuth clients, certificates, custom MDF objects, foundation data, business rules, workflows, schemas, integrations, provisioning, and system settings are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw SuccessFactors APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary OData entity paths, metadata-driven raw queries or mutations, SOAP or deprecated SFAPI, custom reports, browser automation, session capture, bulk extraction, and permission probing are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No SuccessFactors action is enabled without one exact module, entity, field, population, purpose, role, legal basis, retention, workflow, and tenant security contract.

providerSetup.blocker: SAP SuccessFactors is a configurable HCM suite rather than one stable account API. OData metadata describes the entities, fields, associations and operations available in each customer instance. OData v2 and v4 support broad reads and mutations, including tenant-defined MDF objects and sensitive employee and recruiting data. OAuth requires an administrator with Manage OAuth2 Client Applications permission to register a client with an X.509 certificate, obtain an API key, generate a SAML assertion and token, and separately grant role-based permissions. A raw metadata-driven wrapper would expose an unbounded and changing people-data surface; a fixed wrapper cannot be truthful until Relay selects exact modules and customer outcomes.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, HR, legal, privacy, employment-compliance, security, works-council, and customer owners must select one bounded use case and representative tenant. Freeze the modules, entities, fields, populations, countries, purposes, lawful bases, roles, field permissions, effective-dating behavior, workflows, read and write operations, approvals, retention, deletion, audit, human oversight, discrimination protections, and incident duties. A tenant administrator must then create least-privilege X.509 OAuth authority. Only after that may Relay implement a pinned typed schema with exact server and company binding, bounded pagination, safe-mode approvals for every employment-affecting mutation, redaction, audits, deletion, and post-disable denial.

evidence.supports: SuccessFactors OData v4 supports query, create, update and delete operations plus paging, expansion, filtering and other standard OData behaviors.
SuccessFactors metadata describes the entities, fields, associations and operations exposed by a particular customer instance, including custom runtime discovery.
SuccessFactors OAuth uses a tenant-registered client, API key, SAML assertion from a trusted identity provider, and generated access token for an API user.
An administrator with integration-tool permission registers the OAuth client in the customer instance using an X.509 certificate and receives an instance application API key.
Employee Central exposes personal, employment, organizational, pay, job, foundation and custom MDF objects through tenant-authorized OData entities.
Authorized OData clients can create and update users and sensitive fields, demonstrating that API permission is capable of employment-affecting mutations.
